text: 上海金融监管局发布关于推进上海银行业保险业科技金融提质增效的意见。运用数智化赋能科技金融服务。发挥人工智能等新技术在科技金融中的创新赋能作用，鼓励有条件的金融机构建设企业级人工智能平台，综合运用大数据、区块链、物联网、量子计算等数字技术，赋能产品研发、经营决策、风险管理等各环节，提升科技金融数智化经营水平。
text_en: The Shanghai Financial Regulatory Bureau issued opinions on promoting the improvement of quality and efficiency of technology finance in Shanghai's banking and insurance industries. It will use digital and intelligent empowerment to enhance technology financial services. It will give play to the innovative empowering role of new technologies such as artificial intelligence in technology finance, encourage qualified financial institutions to build enterprise-level artificial intelligence platforms, and comprehensively use digital technologies such as big data, blockchain, the Internet of Things, and quantum computing to empower all aspects including product development, business decision-making, and risk management, improving the digital and intelligent operation level of technology finance.
